# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Six years old in Volume 1; seven years old in Volume 2.  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c10 P12](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0012)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive (Orphan)  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>
- **Origin:** Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c10 P1](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin-boy  <sub>[v1 c18 P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037), [v2 c7 P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001)</sub>; Mr. Robin Farrow  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is a fair-haired boy with a round skull covered in tiny, fuzzy yellow ringlets, a snub nose, and a wide, smiling mouth featuring a single dimple on one cheek. His hazel eyes dance with an elfish, mischievous roguishness. He is plump and stoutly built.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036)_

## Personality

Robin is a mischievous, energetic, and inquisitive boy who is constantly active and eager for fun. Although he frequently gets into trouble, utters bold opinions, and occasionally tells untruths to avoid consequences or create excitement, he possesses a deeply affectionate and loving nature. He is intensely competitive—especially regarding Cedric Stanhope, whom he views as a rival—and holds strong loyalties to those he cares about, particularly Nell. He possesses a frank, outspoken manner, frequently asking probing questions about the world around him.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 c8 P15](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0015), [v2 c8 P41](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0041), [v2 c8 P53](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0053), [v2 c10 P10](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0010), [v2 c10 P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

## History

Robin grew up as a twin in a large family in Nova Scotia under the care of Mrs. Rudge and Nell Harcourt. Following the death of his father and later his mother, Mary Farrow, Robin and his twin sister Lucy were taken in by Thirza Abernethy to live at Grey Shutters in Brierley. Shortly after his arrival, his constant restless energy and penchant for pranks caused frequent chaos, including dropping a live caterpillar down Lauretta White's collar during church and tricking his sister Lucy into walking a pigpen fence. Though often punished by being sent to bed or denied meals, he continually proved to be resilient, affectionate, and cheerful. Over time, Robin started attending the local school and developed a fierce rivalrous desire to emulate or outdo Cedric Stanhope in good behavior and height. He also formed a close friendship with Mr. Pettifer, whom he assisted in farm chores like hauling dulse.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 c8 P59](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0059), [v2 c10 P1](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0001), [v2 c10 P12](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0012), [v2 c16 P13](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0013)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Nova Scotia to a family with three consecutive sets of twins.  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- His father, Mr. Rudge, owned a small sawmill in a clearing before passing away.  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Cared for by Nell Harcourt during his early childhood up river in Nova Scotia.  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Orphaned along with his twin sister Lucy after their mother, Mary Farrow, died of illness.  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>
- Taken in by Thirza Abernethy at Grey Shutters in Brierley.  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032)</sub>

## Quotes

> I don’t believe you mean it. You do not seem like the kind of lady who would lash a small boy simply because he was unable to stay motionless.  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>

> I’m Mr. Robin Farrow.  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>

> The moment I become an adult, my absolute highest priority will be remaining awake through an entire night simply to discover how it feels.  <sub>[v2 c8 P29](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0029)</sub>

> Where does the dark go, Nell? I want to know.  <sub>[v1 c16 P5](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0005)</sub>
